name: baoyu-url-to-markdown
tagline_zh: 复制网页链接，秒变干净 Markdown。X、YouTube、HN 都能抓，登录验证码自动等。
tagline_en: Paste a URL, get clean Markdown. Handles X, YouTube, HN, even login/CAPTCHA waits. No more copy-paste mess.
desc_en: Fetch any URL and convert to markdown using baoyu-fetch CLI (Chrome CDP with site-specific adapters). Built-in adapters for X/Twitter, YouTube transcripts, Hacker News threads, and generic pages via Defuddle. Handles login/CAPTCHA via interaction wait modes. Use when user wants to save a webpage as markdown.
why_zh: 内置站点适配器，专治 X、YouTube 等复杂页面，比通用抓取更稳，还能等登录验证码。
why_en: Built-in adapters for X, YouTube, HN beat generic scrapers; waits out logins/CAPTCHAs for reliable extraction.
